name: Kar-Fu
source:
He was the manager of the Sham Shui Po game center owned by Madam Fen.
His particular lineup of dance game machines and sound system had become famous on the Internet.
However, the times were changing and Madam Fen finally decided to close the arcade.
He lost his job, but he used his kindergarten teaching license to move to Yuen Kong Kindergarten, where he is now a well-known teacher.
